article.story: LYNCHBURG, Va. -- — Colin Porter's 14 points helped Liberty defeat New Mexico State 68-60 on Saturday night. Porter shot 4 of 10 from the field, including 1 for 3 from 3-point range, and went 5 for 6 from the line for the Flames (15-4, 3-3 Conference USA). Taelon Peter, Zach Cleveland and Owen Aquino added 11 points apiece. Christian Cook led the Aggies (11-7, 4-1) in scoring, finishing with 17 points. Peter Filipovity added 12 points and 12 rebounds for New Mexico State. Zawdie Jackson finished with 12 points and two steals. The Aggies broke a seven-game winning streak with the loss. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
